transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: TEAL (tape): Third beacon's the one I nearly missed.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Scan below the beacons. Recovery needs the receiver marked.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Receiver echo below the second beacon. Keep scanning.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Two scouts shadowing the rim. Clear the pair.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: TEAL (tape): Under three-twenty along the river. Stay out of sight.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Bravo flight is hunting the river. Last gate, then turn.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Bravo flight breaking cover. Three, in two groups. Clear them.

transcript.speaker: RECOVERY
transcript.text: RECOVERY: We have your mark. Keep the link open while we reach it.

transcript.speaker: RECOVERY
transcript.text: RECOVERY: Receiver in sight. We are climbing down now.

transcript.speaker: BROADCAST
transcript.text: BROADCAST: All Varda units stand down. Authority: Air Marshal.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Stand down? Nobody at Varda issued that.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Proof's recorded. Now kill the radar.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Evidence copied. Follow the service road clear.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Road is clear ahead. Keep to the beacon line.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: They scrambled a flight. Five, in two groups. Hold the line.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Varda is copying the names. Hold the link.

transcript.speaker: TOWER
transcript.text: TOWER: First two names copied. Send the third.

transcript.speaker: FARMER
transcript.text: FARMER: Trucks rolling. Please stay with us.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Second flight off the ridge. Turn back now.

transcript.speaker: FARMER
transcript.text: FARMER: The road's in sight. Don't leave us yet.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Trucks are clear. Their patrol leads are turning in. Three.

transcript.speaker: FARMER
transcript.text: FARMER: One truck lost its radio. Check both bends for stragglers.

transcript.speaker: FARMER
transcript.text: FARMER: One bend clear. Check behind the orchard wall too.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: All trucks counted. Hold the link for the families' names.

transcript.speaker: TOWER
transcript.text: TOWER: Names copied. Finding beds for the children now.

transcript.speaker: FARMER
transcript.text: FARMER: Seed tin is aboard. Follow our homeward beacons.

transcript.speaker: FARMER
transcript.text: FARMER: The lead truck sees your lights. Keep leading.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Follow the channel. The marked tanks sit at its end.

transcript.speaker: FARMER
transcript.text: FARMER: The unmarked roofs are ours. Please.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Low pass first. Mark the military silos, not the farmhouses.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Fuel-grade grain in all three. The roofs are clean.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Marked silos only. That grain is fuel.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Five answering the smoke, in two groups. Turn into them.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: The farm crew found the ledger. Hold the link while they read it.

transcript.speaker: FARMER
transcript.text: FARMER: Three fuel shipments. All signed by the same officer.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: The courier runs under the dust. Stay in it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Five escorts ahead of him. Dust is thinning.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Scan both clearings for his engine trail.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Engine trail at the second clearing. Keep low.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Five escorts in the dust, in two groups. Strip them off him.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: There's the courier, running north. Ninety seconds. Catch him.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: He's halfway to the plateau. Close on him.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Twenty seconds and he's over the edge!

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Packet recovered. Head for Varda while I read the orders.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Tomorrow's orders copied. Reading the signatures next.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Tower crew resetting the code. Keep the raiders off them.

transcript.speaker: BROADCAST
transcript.text: BROADCAST: Varda tower is in rebel hands. Fire on it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Ignore that. It's him.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Second wave's dropping smoke on the apron. Spotters.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Smoke on the apron. Scan for the two spotter dishes first.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Two dishes in the smoke. Keep the parked trainers clear.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Code is ours. Two spotter radars on the apron. Hit them.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Spotters down. Their flight is running. Catch three.

transcript.speaker: TOWER
transcript.text: TOWER: Code restored. Stay on the link until every loyal flight answers.

transcript.speaker: TOWER
transcript.text: TOWER: Loyal flight answering. Waiting on the last one.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: The approach lights are his bait. Fly them anyway.

transcript.speaker: VULTURE LEAD
transcript.text: VULTURE LEAD: Teal flew this line too. Keep coming.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: His voice is bouncing off the pass. Scan low to mark the source.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Guard-channel source above the pass. That is him.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Three on night vision, in two groups. Watch your horizon.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Patrol is gone. Hold the channel open. He will come to answer.

transcript.speaker: VULTURE LEAD
transcript.text: VULTURE LEAD: You have my attention, trainee. Stay there.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Vulture Lead. He erased the witness. Not you.

transcript.speaker: RECOVERY
transcript.text: RECOVERY: Recorder still transmitting. Mark it before the signal dies.

transcript.speaker: RECOVERY
transcript.text: RECOVERY: Recorder ping steady. Mark the second slope.

transcript.speaker: VULTURE LEAD
transcript.text: VULTURE LEAD: You fly like him. He died anyway. Wing, cut him off.

transcript.speaker: VULTURE LEAD
transcript.text: VULTURE LEAD: Enough. Wing, on me!

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Vulture Lead's turning back in. Nose on him.

transcript.speaker: VULTURE LEAD
transcript.text: VULTURE LEAD: Head on, trainee. Like he did.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: VULTURE LEAD pulled back to call his wing. 1 inbound.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: VULTURE LEAD pulled back to call his wing. 2 inbound.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Scan the archive first. The dish can wait.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Signatures copying. Stay low. Hold fire.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: They've seen you. Four climbing off the camp. Scan's on hold.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Four off the camp, in pairs. Clear them, then we finish the scan.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Back on the archive. Eight seconds of clean copy.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Copy complete in four. Hold your line.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Archive copied. Cut the transmitter.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Radar is directing them. Hold the channel; we will trace it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Hold the channel while we trace the camp radar.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: The radar is still directing them. Trace is closing.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Radar on the camp roof. Its raiders fire twice as fast. Kill it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Radar's dead. The response is flying blind. Three.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Lira first. West ridge dish.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Alert flight airborne. Three. Clear them.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Merel next. East ridge.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Third dish lit north of the belt. Node Sable. Not on the tin.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Farm road north. Two beacons to Sable.

transcript.speaker: FARMER
transcript.text: FARMER: That dish went up last week. Nobody asked us.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Sable. Dish only. The barn beside it is ours.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Guard flight off Sable. Three.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Relaying Teal's packet. Ninety seconds. Hold the ridge orbit.

transcript.speaker: FARMER
transcript.text: FARMER: We're hearing it. Keep it coming.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Last of the packet. Don't drift off the ridge.

transcript.speaker: TRUCK
transcript.text: TRUCK: Transmitter rolling. The corridor is full of refugees.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Second flight coming for the truck.

transcript.speaker: BROADCAST
transcript.text: BROADCAST: Convoy, the north corridor is clear. Proceed north at speed.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Ignore him. North is mined. Truck, stop. Scan the mill road.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Refugees clear of the bend. One more look at the road.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Mill road is clear. Truck, swing east. We will cover you.

transcript.speaker: TRUCK
transcript.text: TRUCK: Mill road's rough but we're moving. Stay with us.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Truck's clear. Patrol escalating. Six, in two groups.

transcript.speaker: TRUCK
transcript.text: TRUCK: Parked and transmitting. Hold for our first reply.

transcript.speaker: TRUCK
transcript.text: TRUCK: First loyalist cell answering. Holding for the second.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Relief crew following your beacons. Bring them to the truck.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Relief crew sees the transmitter. Last beacon ahead.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Rail spur runs straight to their stores. Follow it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Spur ends at the silos. Low and quiet now.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Mark the stores. Civilian roofs stay standing.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Fuel ledger confirmed. Those silos are military.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Four silos. Marked only.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Four off the plateau. Finish the silos, then turn into them.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Silos burning. Now the four, in pairs. Turn in.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: The relay's still calling for help. Cut it.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Raiders off the plateau. Three more, with hangers-on.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Rail crew has the ledger. Hold the link to the cells.

transcript.speaker: LOYALIST
transcript.text: LOYALIST: Rail ledger copied. Matching it against Kiro's orders.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Saddle beacons lead to the arrays. Climb.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: All three arrays can hear you now.

transcript.speaker: BROADCAST
transcript.text: BROADCAST: Unknown aircraft on the saddle. Intercept.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Three dishes on the ridge. Blind them.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Replacement mast on the saddle road. Cut that one too.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Scan the saddle road. They have raised a replacement dish.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Dish truck on the saddle road. Civilian vans are clear.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Mast located on the saddle road. Hit the dish.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Perimeter CAP turning in. Four, in pairs, with raiders.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Hold the saddle. I'm listening for anything left alive.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: More off the dark end of the row. Hold the orbit.
